title: ZhuLong: Execution-Grounded LLM Agent for EDA Scripting with Offline API Self-Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2608.07925v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: EDA scripting with tool-specific, often undocumented APIs remains a long-tail bottleneck that existing LLMs fail to address. This paper presents ZhuLong, an execution-grounded LLM coding agent for PyAether and SKILL that combines API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools, augmented by an offline API self-exploration mechanism that infers undocumented API behaviors through counterfactual experimentation.   We evaluate ZhuLong on EDA-Eval-PyAether, a benchmark of 158 real-world tasks with assertion-based execution, where the complete system achieves 78.5% Pass@1 in the commercial Empyrean Aether environment, substantially outperforming a pure LLM baseline (23.6%). translated_title: ZhuLong：基于执行的离线API自探索EDA脚本编写LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 使用特定工具且常常缺乏文档的API进行EDA脚本编写，仍然是现有大语言模型（LLM）无法解决的长尾瓶颈问题。本文提出了ZhuLong，一个面向PyAether和SKILL的基于执行的LLM编程智能体，它通过统一的MCP工具将API检索、文档检查和沙箱执行相结合，并由一种离线API自探索机制增强，该机制通过反事实实验来推断未文档化API的行为。我们在EDA-Eval-PyAether上评估了ZhuLong，这是一个包含158个真实世界任务、采用基于断言执行方式的基准。完整系统在商用Empyrean Aether环境中实现了78.5%的Pass@1，显著优于纯LLM基线（23.6%）。消融研究表明，沙箱执行是主要的性能驱动因素（移除后下降41.2个百分点），而自探索机制额外带来3.2个百分点的准确率提升，并将每任务工具调用次数减少了22.1%。
tldr: ZhuLong是一个面向EDA脚本编写的基于执行反馈的LLM智能体，通过沙箱执行与离线API自探索机制（利用反事实实验推断未文档化API行为），在158个真实任务的基准上将Pass@1从23.6%大幅提升至78.5%。
en_tdlr: ZhuLong is an execution-grounded LLM agent for EDA scripting that combines sandbox execution with an offline API self-exploration mechanism (inferring undocumented API behaviors via counterfactual experiments), boosting Pass@1 from 23.6% to 78.5% on a benchmark of 158 real-world tasks.
